                                  Kia EV3

                                  £1,500 Government Grant | £2,430 Deposit Contribution | 3.9% APR Representative

                                  Enquire Now

                                  World and UK Car of the Year 2025, the all-electric, compact SUV offers everyday convenience and practicality while making sure you can still tackle those longer journeys. With speedy charging capabilities, you’ll be ready to take on every adventure.

                                  BOOK A TEST DRIVE

                                  The Kia EV3 has an electric mile range of up to 375 miles and charging won’t need to slow you down, with the EV3's speedy, seamless charging capabilities bringing you back to 10-80 percent in approximately 31 minutes on a 400-volt electric charger, delivering at least 150kW of electricity. Enjoy features such as a 12.3" driver display screen, wireless Apple CarPlay & Android Auto, wireless mobile phone charger and a digital key.

                                  The EV3 'GT-Line' is available for £449 a month, with £4,499 customer deposit, £2,000 Kia deposit contribution, £430 Lloyd Kia deposit contribution, £1,500 Government Grant and 3.9% APR Representative on Personal Contract Purchase.

                                  Do you own a vehicle you'd like to part-exchange? Contact us for a personalised Kia EV3 quote tailored to your needs.

                                  GET A PERSONALISED QUOTE

                                  Take the first step toward sustainable driving without compromise. Get in touch to arrange your visit at a time that works for you.

                                  What Makes Lloyd Kia Different?

                                  Our mission at Lloyd Kia is to earn our customers’ loyalty through the delivery of market-leading sales and aftersales experiences that continually exceed expectations.

                                  The Full Package

                                  In addition to our wide range of Kia cars, both of our Lloyd Kia centres offer a comprehensive range of aftersales services, including servicing, parts, MOTs and repairs.

                                  Unique Showroom Experience

                                  Whether you’re looking for a new or an Approved or Assured Used Kia, our dedicated Lloyd Kia teams are here to help you find exactly what you’re looking for.

                                  We’ve Got History

                                  Starting their journey in 1976, Lloyd Motor Group have been supporting drivers for 50 years.
